const FLAG_VS: '
        attribute vec2 a_pos;
        varying vec2 v_uv;
        void main() {
          v_uv = (a_pos + 1.0) * 0.5;
          // Invert y so top-left matches standard image coords
          v_uv.y = 1.0 - v_uv.y;
          gl_Position = vec4(a_pos, 0.0, 1.0);
        }
